poi103_03_pixie_ending.BA3511844388EB757B699F97C818066F: Bring me nice pearly-whites – and I'll give you something in return. Cross my heart!
poi103_03_pixie_ending.CBE40C2445D66E46D936398669684F01: I'm afraid your friends won't be supplying you with fresh teeth anymore.
poi103_03_pixie_ending.C10DFF924AFA24113590A9B1BC66D72B: Innocent, guilty – honestly, I couldn't care less.
poi103_03_pixie_ending.2A891F0F410AB110B25EA38F27BCA62C: Uhhh... Is that a trick question?
poi103_03_pixie_ending.5575BCE746C4AB62A62D7FBF9E94A14B: You want me to kill innocent people for you?
poi103_03_pixie_ending.89CBDECE45973CF91F60FA8DDDFC4706: You want me to kill innocent people?

poi104_01_pixie_mute_met.787A1CAA4E0F6768838EB4A625AAB4F9: He crawled into our home... Vile, mindless... Hungry...
poi104_01_pixie_mute_met.022B54C64EEDDE2229FBF78AE9DB28DA: I can't help you right now.
poi104_01_pixie_mute_met.41D5D3594E11F2D77DB761951058C09B: I can't help you right now. I'm sorry.
poi104_01_pixie_mute_met.59A037A54DA3764E046E20BF8D7B7B0C: Lead me to your burrow. I'll see what I can do.
poi104_01_pixie_mute_met.815E19BB42E086163E3520B50D4EFE4D: Please, my sisters... Maybe it's not too late.
poi104_01_pixie_mute_met.127E7D914C74E3536F11C0926C9FC3B1: There's no time! You have to come with me! Please!
poi104_01_pixie_mute_met.CFFB9A8C4DC044EECDB5228F474FFBEC: Ugggghhh! Leave, then! Leave me alone!

poi104_02_pixie_comments.4ED9C66E42AE275CADC2EAA064B701F1: Here! He's still inside, I can hear him!

poi104_03_pixie_mute_inside.81599C1F47C97661A63E489CA40F19F0: Oh, no... I... I should've known... Should've realised it was too good to be true...
poi104_03_pixie_mute_inside.1CDE1E2C446305201D37A2B97EDECE8A: So you lured him into your burrow.
poi104_03_pixie_mute_inside.35A8757847F522FC3D67C29BB1E24E9E: There's nothing more I can do for you, I'm afraid.
poi104_03_pixie_mute_inside.B7D6F53C45BCD6F00B5717B1A81BA844: There's nothing more I can do for you.
poi104_03_pixie_mute_inside.BAB64711465CD0ED73B5C895AA59C883: There. Your burrow is safe again.
poi104_03_pixie_mute_inside.C9F7296E4D91DBDB7DADF5AC993731B0: This was your burrow, I assume? It's safe, now.
poi104_03_pixie_mute_inside.E84810D741F503F4B160E0AD4D9C87F8: Too good to be true? What do you mean?
poi104_03_pixie_mute_inside.717648974B2EB4B717B135B0BCD8755B: We saw him, alone in the forest, a freshly sired murohn... So many teeth! Beautiful fresh fangs, everywhere!
poi104_03_pixie_mute_inside.99CC15CA49AD6320EFC526A7C098BC8E: We thought we could keep him around, pry the teeth from his flesh just as they erupted – again and again!
poi104_03_pixie_mute_inside.463C3B894B45012AEE43C7A05A25753E: You've avenged my sisters. That's plenty. And I'll make sure our tsarina hears of it.

poi103_01_pulling_teeth.471641E3478179588BC312B1DC001325: Ah-ha. Hoping for more bloodshed – and more mouths to loot?
poi103_01_pulling_teeth.D1EC0E41414390C8B9217E980424977E: Every time they dump a body here, I leave them something in return for all the pretty teeth!
poi103_01_pulling_teeth.34ED1CC945273943002D5CAC650728A7: I didn't lay a finger on them! You don't like it, talk to the bandits!
poi103_01_pulling_teeth.A76ED3D3448602CEC97E818B7BED9EF3: I might have helped it along, though.
poi103_01_pulling_teeth.7AD507AB4FCC69D3EA7010A5637C45AE: I'm foraging teeth! It's like foraging mushrooms... Only you forage teeth instead!
poi103_01_pulling_teeth.FBE397284A5BA988FA872288E7F0D3B6: Indeed! Go talk to them. Maybe they'll do something nice for you, too!
poi103_01_pulling_teeth.89FF22EB44DFDE516A368C8ED2D9B34E: Need! Ugh. You humans are so bloody practical!
poi103_01_pulling_teeth.0EA5423F4FD4ADA60D4F24ABE3938917: Not anymore, I'm afraid. Those men and I – we had a disagreement.
poi103_01_pulling_teeth.1B28308F4532FFC30A620C81026E1BE3: Oh! Shame... Did you take their teeth? If not, I stake my claim!
poi103_01_pulling_teeth.A1F6DB9C46D8F5A7D2BFA58C58128158: Oh, it's simple, really. There's a few men in the forest nearby. Bandits. Big and mean!
poi103_01_pulling_teeth.02D0064F4173848D36B095B473F7BA01: Tell you what – if you come across any, bring them to me and I'll give you something nice in return. Sound good?
poi103_01_pulling_teeth.E294CD4D460594FA9AB3AE86675E75F1: This isn't right. These people – they did nothing wrong.
poi103_01_pulling_teeth.B7EBA93D481F92DDA1376EA9ADF66EA3: Uh, no thanks. I've got no use for them.
poi103_01_pulling_teeth.FED9321D4CC99A2408F7C6A71F5348F8: Uh... Just what are you doing here?
poi103_01_pulling_teeth.76B209544DEF4FF5CF5834AD9D66DDF6: Use! Ah, silly humans... Teeth are to be enjoyed, not used!
poi103_01_pulling_teeth.4671B85640C1F4E7E7A44684BE235493: We don't need them. We admire them. We listen to them clink.
poi103_01_pulling_teeth.D7E499764DB9FD11F35730A98AD9B191: What do you need all these teeth for?
poi103_01_pulling_teeth.CE530605401B6AC56E48979157B3A556: What do you use all the teeth for?
poi103_01_pulling_teeth.26FD72D448BA49F251D2C597D0C67EB7: You get the teeth, the bandits get gold – and everyone's happy?

poi102_2_pixie_chatter.AA3723414B3109ACD77000A37BEE972C: The charm! Bring it back, remember!
poi102_2_pixie_chatter.2DFD18644A7AF3C86D4EE3BF9EB8D58C: They robbed us! Drove us out!
poi102_2_pixie_chatter.A20DD7444DB8F091D1F7069C8647FC63: We'll perish, now! Die, all of us!

poi102_01_pixie.3BBDAA694016E68AD5AA3D8BE7B6AF6A: Ah! Will you help us now?
poi102_01_pixie.3E36F397487713AA0712A380EFEC1CB5: Charm? What does it look like?
poi102_01_pixie.54107B0B4E2EC55132A37BB235F698D0: Drive the kobolds out. Kill them, if need be! But most of all, retrieve the charm!
poi102_01_pixie.6B0DF6504597B95D9293D6970BF3471C: Help us, dawnwalker. I beg of you.
poi102_01_pixie.5B2AB3044F688FCFBE87F4B6ED2BDB67: Kobolds! Always digging! Always scheming! Always stealing!
poi102_01_pixie.608E40964011B13A09BD2E8B2E6C7FA3: Looks don't matter! You'll know when you find it. You'll feel it!
poi102_01_pixie.BD3BF1D041F95780F43672B8393203F0: Oh, leave us, then! Homeless! Hungry! Shivering in the cold!
poi102_01_pixie.CCD8D741421E8B3FE0E344A9A07BABAF: Our burrow! They took it over! Drove us out!
poi102_01_pixie.142CCF994B35D2B5246B31B2CE8BF9CC: Please! It's sacred! It hurts even to think that kobolds are laying their dirty claws on it!
poi102_01_pixie.0106E9C1416FD9651B62BE8B913A7F60: Right. I'll see what I can do.
poi102_01_pixie.39A244C447D481778998BDA69A21C41F: What do you want me to do?
poi102_01_pixie.A4FE568646970730640E1BB7F085777A: What do you want me to do?

poi102_02_pixie_finale.0332593A4EF9F255B94D23B8C4A023AD: But – But we need your help! The reward – I'll double it! How about that?
poi102_02_pixie_finale.D7A471184120D0AF215527A5AE1A8728: Ha! You're clever – for a human! But joking aside, did you kill them or not?
poi102_02_pixie_finale.41EB2A2B4DC31F7BCC01F3A235F2CA85: Hm. Let me think about this.
poi102_02_pixie_finale.6110364244F7F96EE2CFC990A6505AB4: I don't like being taken for a fool.
poi102_02_pixie_finale.E40F84394BDF8CDF7A6E1EAF7DBDA209: I don't like being taken for a fool.
poi102_02_pixie_finale.757A53B840469D6A91F6A5B6DDDD75A3: I think you lied to me.
poi102_02_pixie_finale.DE82CFAB4DC5A7D6DDBC8698EFD551D5: Oh, don't pout! The kobolds – they don't mind. Not anymore. Haha!
poi102_02_pixie_finale.DC0A283846909ADFBD89559CB12B0D47: Sounds good. Especially since I've already done what you asked of me.
poi102_02_pixie_finale.1A1F3FC9452DE03C114E6D8ADF15EB1F: Wait – was this even your burrow?
poi102_02_pixie_finale.7BFBF831482B3D2D8986B8B6A420DAF2: What? Then why did you – Ah. I see. I tricked you, so you tricked me. Tit for tat!
poi102_02_pixie_finale.2D7FB20A414C219C49F5C88C7E45C751: Words, words, words! Don't ever trust them! They're like the eye on the butterfly's wing! Black and yellow stripes on a fly!
poi102_02_pixie_finale.D50346214473D059BA44B8AB810990C6: Yes. The kobolds – they're dead. And I've got your charm.
poi102_02_pixie_finale.1C409E5041F54CC83D24BAB0EAB84482: Yes. Very funny! Lots of laughs. Not for the kobolds, though! Haha!
poi102_02_pixie_finale.1EBF5DA9415B6E3DF86C6A96B6F39121: You fool me – and expect me to just go along with it?
poi102_02_pixie_finale.D0F6722F46069B1A58493092CD80073C: You fool me – and expect me to just go along with it?
poi102_02_pixie_finale.E582711242619E84A4FC9F88CC94205C: You're back! Did you do what we asked?

poi101_02_trapped_pixie.3DDD7200485E0F1651EBBCB50761F0FA: But no more. You heard me, you helped me. And now, you will be rewarded.
poi101_02_trapped_pixie.9833D5584453FEA88DE8A79270E08564: Haha! Free at last! No more dancing!
poi101_02_trapped_pixie.A9810B3E4926378D3EC9C3A348764516: He made me! Starved me until I did as he said!
poi101_02_trapped_pixie.D4216E3242A88E51BC5FD1837B3F3E2D: I'll tell our tsarina of your deeds. She'll be pleased, I'm sure. But there's more.
poi101_02_trapped_pixie.85FFCC89413736B43FB58F8FA34F9741: It's yours for the taking. But don't tarry. It won't be there forever.
poi101_02_trapped_pixie.7623CC944FA1193F3E96E2AC77AA2787: My sisters and I shall give him a performance he'll never forget.
poi101_02_trapped_pixie.5869D99C4231D09573CCC890FC606560: Return to the burrow. Share tales of my sorrows.
poi101_02_trapped_pixie.234E69084DAA48CEC0EE9D9E91A03712: This man – he's hiding silver in the other room, under one of the floorboards.
poi101_02_trapped_pixie.37FFBE03412BA59464D648BAA028A85B: What are you going to do now?
poi101_02_trapped_pixie.8BD7A8F144AFBB81101D37957FF88C68: You want to reward me? How?
